newsitem.title: UK: Cirqual in two purchases for 14.74 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Cirqual in two purchases for 14.74 mln stg.

text.p: Aluminium company Cirqual Plc said on Monday it was making two acquisitions for a total initial consideration of 14.74 million stg.

It said in a statement it was buying from Siebe Plc RFI Shielding Ltd, which manufactures a range of electronic shielding materials for protecting electronic and electrical equipment such as mobile phone handsets, from engineering group for 9.0 million stg.
Siebe said separately it had acquired RFI through its acquisition of Unitech Plc for 586.5 million stg in May 1996 and was a 'non-core' business.
Cirqual also said it was purchasing Thos. C. (Wild) Forgings Ltd, a metal forging and casting business, for an initial 5.74 million stg and a deferred consideration of up to 3.6 million.
The consideration for the two purchases will be met initially by increased bank borrowings, Cirqual said.
